paite: Pathian hon hihhatpa pahtawi in nuamtak in la sa unla; Jakob' Pathian pahtawi in nuamtak in kikou un.
heading: Asaph La / Ankuangluina La

paite: Phatna la sa unla, khuangta, kaihging ngaihnophuai, pekging toh hon tawi un.
Kha thak in pengkul mut unla, kha lik a i ankuangluina thupi ni in.
Israelte ding a dan thuseh ahi ngal a, Jakob' Pathian dan ahi.
Huai Joseph lak a thu theihsakna ding a aseh ahi. Aigupta gam tung a apaikhiak lai in, ka theih louh pau ka zak lai in.
Aliangzang thil gik a pan in ka lasuan a, loh a kipan akhutte khahkhiak in a-om hi.
Mangbat ni in na hon sam a, ka hon humbit a; van-ging bukna mun ah ka hon dawng hi; Meribah tuite ah ka hon ze-et ahi. Selah
Ka mite aw, ngaikhia unla, ka hon theihsak bang in; Israel aw, ka thu ngaikhe nuam hi le uteh aw!
Gamdang pathian himhim na lak uah a-om ding ahi kei; midang pathian himhim na biak ding uh leng ahi kei hi.
Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi a, Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhepa tak; na kam uh liankat un, ka hihdim ding hi.
Himahleh ka mite'n ka aw angaikhe kei ua; Israelte'n hon deih kei uhi.
Huchi in alungtang uh genhakdan bang zel a om ding in ka khahzanta ahi, amau hoihsak bang a a-omna ding un.
Aw, ka mite'n ka thu ngaikhia in, Israelte ka lampite ah pai le u aw.
Amelmate uh ka hihneu zok in, amau galte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
TOUPA hote akiang ah akipelut ding uhi; amau hun bel a om nilouh ding ahi.
Nou bel buh hoihpen in ka hon vak ding hi; suangpi a khuaizu in ka a hon hon taisak ding ahi.
